module_summary: AXI video frame-buffer reader: AXI-lite configured registers drive a burst request generator that walks frame lines over AXI read, buffering returned beats in a FIFO streamed out as AXI-Stream with line/frame markers.

anchors.name: r_stopped
anchors.why: Run/stop state; resets FIFO, request and return counters while stopped

anchors.name: soft_reset
anchors.why: Halt request set on bus error or deactivate; blocks new bursts until restarted

anchors.name: r_err
anchors.why: Sticky bus-error flag set on RRESP error, reported in control status word

anchors.name: cfg_active
anchors.why: Software enable bit; starts/stops frame fetching and gates burst starts

anchors.name: cfg_frame_addr
anchors.why: Programmed frame buffer base address loaded into request address at frame start

anchors.name: cfg_frame_lines
anchors.why: Programmed lines per frame; reloads line counters

anchors.name: cfg_line_words
anchors.why: Programmed words per line; reloads per-line word counters

anchors.name: cfg_line_step
anchors.why: Programmed line stride added to line address at end of each line

anchors.name: cfg_dirty
anchors.why: Indicates config changed but not yet applied at frame boundary

anchors.name: cfg_zero_length
anchors.why: Zero-size frame configuration flag preventing activation

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write accept; enables config register writes and BVALID

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: Register write address selecting which config register is updated

anchors.name: arskd_addr
anchors.why: Register read address selecting read-back word

anchors.name: axil_read_data
anchors.why: Registered AXI-lite read-back data driving S_AXIL_RDATA

anchors.name: axil_read_valid
anchors.why: AXI-lite read response valid register

anchors.name: axil_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid register

anchors.name: w_status_word
anchors.why: Control/status word packing active, busy, err, dirty and line step

anchors.name: start_burst
anchors.why: Decides when a new AXI read burst is issued given FIFO space and stall

anchors.name: phantom_start
anchors.why: Delayed burst-start pulse advancing request counters and FIFO space accounting

anchors.name: lag_start
anchors.why: Second-cycle burst marker; recomputes max_burst and blocks back-to-back starts

anchors.name: req_addr
anchors.why: Next burst address walking across lines and frame, loaded into ARADDR

anchors.name: req_line_addr
anchors.why: Start address of current line, advanced by line step

anchors.name: req_line_words
anchors.why: Remaining words to request in current line; sizes bursts

anchors.name: req_nlines
anchors.why: Remaining lines to request in the frame

anchors.name: req_hlast
anchors.why: Current burst ends a line; selects line-advance address update

anchors.name: req_vlast
anchors.why: Current line is last in frame; triggers frame restart

anchors.name: max_burst
anchors.why: Maximum burst length for current line, bounds ARLEN

anchors.name: till_boundary
anchors.why: Beats remaining until burst address boundary; limits ARLEN

anchors.name: axi_arlen
anchors.why: Registered burst length driving M_AXI_ARLEN

anchors.name: ar_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Counts issued bursts not yet completed by RLAST

anchors.name: ar_none_outstanding
anchors.why: No bursts outstanding; allows transition to stopped

anchors.name: rd_line_beats
anchors.why: Counts returned beats within line to mark HLAST

anchors.name: rd_lines
anchors.why: Counts returned lines within frame to mark VLAST

anchors.name: rd_hlast
anchors.why: Returned beat ends a line; tagged into FIFO as HLAST

anchors.name: rd_vlast
anchors.why: Returned line ends the frame; tagged into FIFO as VLAST

anchors.name: fifo_space_available
anchors.why: Uncommitted FIFO space; reserved per burst, released per stream read

anchors.name: no_fifo_space_available
anchors.why: Blocks new bursts when FIFO cannot hold another max burst

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag; inverted to drive stream TVALID

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag; deasserts M_AXI_RREADY

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Video stream valid, asserted while FIFO non-empty

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Stream ready; pops the FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Video pixel data read from the FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TLAST
anchors.why: End-of-frame (or line) marker from FIFO sideband

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI read address valid for each frame-buffer burst

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Burst read address from request address generator

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARLEN
anchors.why: Burst length; also used in FIFO space and word accounting

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid; writes FIFO and advances return counters

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Frame-buffer read data written into the FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Read data ready, driven by FIFO not full

anchors.name: M_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Read response; error bit halts engine and sets r_err

groups.name: AXI-lite register bank
groups.description: Skid-buffered AXI-lite slave writing active, frame address, size and stride registers; status read-back

groups.name: Run/stop controller
groups.description: Soft reset, error halt and stopped state sequencing engine start and shutdown

groups.name: Read request generator
groups.description: Issues boundary-limited AXI read bursts walking lines and frame from programmed geometry

groups.name: Read return counters
groups.description: Counts returned beats and lines to tag HLAST/VLAST onto incoming data

groups.name: Stream FIFO
groups.description: FIFO with space reservation buffering read data, output as AXI-Stream video
